text:
jess: quick handoff for Acme POC — they need hosted API creds for the test env. Requirements: short-lived, IP-restricted, audit logs enabled, and tag it for sales so we can revoke easily if needed.

mike: got it. we can generate an ephemeral hosted key via Console or the CLI. default TTL is 24h but we can set 12h. IP allowlist is supported. will it need streaming?

jess: yes streaming + generate only (no embeddings). prefer 12h TTL. IP range: 203.0.113.0/24. also want rotation guidance: we'll rotate after each customer demo.

tara: @jess i'll create the key unless you want to hand it off to sec. i recommend labeling key `sales/acme-poc` and adding meta `created_by:sales_jess`. For rotation we can automate with a script, or manual rotation via Console. which do you prefer?

security: quick note — for POC this is fine but add audit retention to 90 days and ensure we don't store the raw key in shared docs. mark as "POC - non-prod" in tagging. also enable revoke-on-idle: 48h policy if not used. :lock:

ops-bot: provisioning-log: request received by sales; queued for token issuance. ticket# SLS-4821

mike: ok i'll issue the key now with TTL=12h, IP allowlist=203.0.113.0/24, scopes=[generate,stream]. label and metadata applied. audit logging enabled.

mike: curl example for test:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer REDWOOD_ACME_POC_<REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-large-1", "input":"Hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

jess: nice — please DM the key to the SE on the call and cc me. make sure the token is marked ephemeral and include the expiry timestamp.

mike: done — key created id=tok_01HxyzABC, expires=1762004320 (12h). IP allowlist applied. audit link: https://console.redwood.ai/projects/acme/poc/logs?ticket=SLS-4821

jess: sending to customer now. we'll rotate after the demo; tag me if any issues. thanks everyone. :rocket:
